title: Paint Financing: 0% Option Through Synchrony
metaDescription: Finance your painting project through Synchrony: no-interest-if-paid-in-full offers, a guaranteed 0% plan, and low fixed-rate terms. Apply online in minutes.
bodyHtml:
Get the Painting Project Done Now — Choose a Payment Option That Fits Your Budget

Painting your home is an investment in how it looks, feels, and holds up over time. Sometimes the timing is right for the project, but the timing is not ideal financially.

That is why The Proud Paintbrush partners with Synchrony to offer several financing plans — from no-interest-if-paid-in-full options to a guaranteed 0% plan and low fixed-rate installment terms — so homeowners can move forward without sacrificing prep, materials, or long-term quality.

Whether you are planning a full interior repaint in Sugar Land, cabinet painting in Missouri City, exterior painting in Richmond, or drywall repairs in Katy, Synchrony financing can help make the project more manageable.

Our Financing Partner

Choose the Plan That Fits Your Project

Apply online in minutes for a Synchrony credit account. Options range from no-interest-if-paid-in-full offers to a guaranteed 0% plan and low fixed-rate installment terms — Synchrony will walk you through what you qualify for, subject to credit approval.

Check If You Pre-Qualify →Apply for Synchrony Financing →

Checking if you pre-qualify will not affect your credit score.

Financing provided by Synchrony. On “No Interest if Paid in Full” plans, interest will be charged from the purchase date if the promotional balance is not paid in full within the promotional period; minimum monthly payments are required. Fixed-rate plans have equal monthly payments for the stated term. All plans are subject to credit approval; terms, availability, and minimum purchase requirements are determined by Synchrony and subject to change — see the application for current details.

Why Homeowners Choose Financing for Painting Projects

Home improvement projects often happen because they need to happen—not because they were planned years in advance.

Many homeowners use Synchrony financing for:

✓ Whole-home interior painting before moving in
✓ Exterior painting and stucco maintenance before HOA deadlines
✓ Cabinet painting during kitchen updates
✓ Drywall repairs after water damage or remodeling work
✓ Preparing a home before selling
✓ Larger multi-room projects completed all at once

The right Synchrony plan can let homeowners complete the full project now instead of splitting it into smaller phases over time.

Step One

Schedule Your Estimate

Meet with our team and receive a detailed proposal outlining scope, products, and pricing.

Step Two

Choose Your Synchrony Plan

Review your options — from no-interest-if-paid-in-full offers to a guaranteed 0% plan or a low fixed rate — and pick what fits your budget.

Step Three

Enjoy Your Updated Space

Once approved and scheduled, we complete your project with detailed prep, clean execution, and lasting durability.

Financing Should Never Replace Quality

Financing helps with the payment side.

Our responsibility is making sure the project itself is done correctly.

At The Proud Paintbrush, that means focusing on:

✓ Proper preparation
✓ Clean job sites
✓ Durable products selected for the project
✓ Transparent proposals
✓ Long-term results that hold up over time

View Our Testimonials

Frequently Asked Questions

What financing options are available?

The Proud Paintbrush offers several financing plans through Synchrony, including no-interest-if-paid-in-full offers, a guaranteed 0% option, and low fixed-rate installment plans, subject to credit approval. On no-interest-if-paid-in-full plans, interest is charged from the purchase date if the balance is not paid off within the promotional period. Synchrony will present your specific plan options during application.

How do I apply for Synchrony financing?

You can apply directly online through our Synchrony application link in minutes. Approval decisions are often returned quickly.

Is there a minimum project amount for financing?

Some Synchrony promotional programs may require minimum purchase amounts. Review current program details during the application process.

Will applying affect my credit score?

You can check if you pre-qualify with no impact to your credit score. Submitting a full application may involve a credit inquiry — we recommend reviewing the full terms directly with Synchrony during application.

Can financing be combined with promotions?

Some offers may be combined depending on active promotions and Synchrony's program terms at the time of application.

Are financing options available for property managers and businesses?

Yes. We work with homeowners, property managers, realtors, and commercial clients on financing arrangements.

More Ways to Finance Your Project
